results.title: Six burnt alive as car crashes into divider, pole on Muzaffarnagar highway
results.description: The victims, believed to be residents of Haryana’s Jind district, were travelling towards Haridwar when the accident occurred. The accident site is around 25 km from the Muzaffarnagar district headquarters.
